Life restoration of Baryphracta deponiae.
  • Based on figures in "Reappraisal of the morphology and phylogenetic relationships of the middle Eocene alligatoroid Diplocynodon deponiae (Frey, Laemmert, and Riess, 1987) based on a three-dimensional specimen" by Massimo Delfino and Thierry Smith (Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 32(6): 1358-1369).
